meta.purpose: Comprehensive brief for ChatGPT to expand and detail the ArhiHub platform concept
meta.instruction: Read this entire document. Then produce: (1) A 100x improved concept document with full feature specs, (2) A detailed development script/roadmap, (3) Complete UX flows for every user type, (4) Monetization model with pricing tiers, (5) Database schema suggestions, (6) API endpoint structure, (7) Content strategy. Think of this as building the 'Pornhub of Architecture' — the visual language, organization, engagement mechanics, and content discovery patterns of that platform, but applied to architecture, interior design, construction, and building materials. The platform must be a comprehensive ecosystem where architects, clients, suppliers, contractors, and material manufacturers all find value.
meta.language_note: The platform targets Serbian-speaking markets primarily (UI in Serbian Latin), with English as secondary language. All example content is in Serbian.
meta.created_by: Claude Code session, based on work with the platform creator

creator.name: Aleksandar Petrović
business_areas: Project management for residential and commercial spaces
Connecting clients with verified suppliers and contractors
creator.vision_statement: A platform that connects everyone in the architectural and construction ecosystem — architects, interior designers, clients, material suppliers, contractors, and manufacturers — through high-quality visual content, with monetization through premium listings, advertising, and paid visibility boosts.

brand.name: ArhiHub

visual_identity.inspiration: Pornhub — the black/dark background with orange accent color, the logo style (lowercase 'h' in an orange rounded rectangle), the content grid layout, the category tabs, the engagement metrics (views, likes, ratings), the comment sections, the channel/creator pages. This is deliberate and central to the brand identity.
visual_identity.logo_description: Text 'Arhi' in white on dark background + 'Hub' in dark text on orange rounded rectangle. Favicon is orange rounded square with lowercase 'h'.

typography.monospace: For eyebrow labels and category tags

brand.tone: Professional but bold. Architecture meets entertainment. High-quality visuals treated like premium content. The platform feels like browsing a curated gallery where every 'video' is an architectural visualization, every 'channel' is an architectural firm, and every 'category' is a building type or service.

current_state.description: Release 1 (Izdanje 1) is a static multi-page site with 24 HTML pages, no backend, localStorage for favorites.

tech_stack.routing: Folder-based static routing (each page is folder/index.html)
tech_stack.images: WebP format, two sizes per frame (640px card, 1600px detail)

expanded_vision.summary: Transform ArhiHub from a static portfolio into a full-featured interactive platform — the architecture industry's answer to content platforms. Every architectural firm gets a 'channel', every project is a 'series', every render/visualization is a 'clip'. Users browse, discover, rate, comment, save, and inquire. Revenue comes from premium listings, advertising, boosted visibility, and professional services.

home_page.layout: Dark background, orange accent. Top: logo + search bar + user menu. Below: category tabs. Main: grid of frame thumbnails (3-4 columns) with view count overlay, duration badge for videos, creator name. Right sidebar or below: trending, recommended. Footer: links, about, legal.
home_page.reference: Think Pornhub homepage layout but every thumbnail is an architectural render

frame_detail_page.layout: Large render/video player at top. Below: title, creator info with avatar and follow button, view count, like/dislike, save, share. Description with material tags (clickable). Comment section below. Sidebar: related frames, suggested projects, material ads.
frame_detail_page.reference: Think video detail page — the render IS the video, the materials ARE the tags

channel_page.layout: Cover image, avatar, firm name, follower count, total views. Tab navigation: Projects, Frames, About, Materials Used. Grid of content below.
channel_page.reference: YouTube channel / Pornhub model page style

category_page.layout: Category header with description. Sort options (trending, newest, most viewed, top rated). Subcategory filters. Grid of content. Infinite scroll or pagination.

technical_recommendations.frontend: Next.js or Nuxt.js for SSR + static generation. Tailwind CSS for rapid styling with the custom dark+orange theme.
technical_recommendations.backend: Node.js + Express or Django REST framework. PostgreSQL database.
technical_recommendations.storage: AWS S3 or similar for images/videos. CDN for delivery.
technical_recommendations.search: Elasticsearch or Algolia for fast, filtered search.
technical_recommendations.payments: Stripe for subscriptions and marketplace transactions.
technical_recommendations.analytics: Custom analytics + Google Analytics. Real-time view counting with Redis.
technical_recommendations.deployment: Docker containers, CI/CD pipeline, staging + production environments.

chatgpt_instructions.task: You are receiving the complete concept brief for ArhiHub — an architectural platform visually and structurally inspired by Pornhub but serving the architecture, interior design, and construction industry. Your job is to take this concept and improve it 100x. Produce the following deliverables:

deliverables.title: Enhanced Concept Document
deliverables.description: Take the vision described above and expand it into a comprehensive product concept. Add features I haven't thought of. Identify gaps. Think about what makes platforms like Pornhub, YouTube, Pinterest, and Houzz successful and apply those patterns. Consider network effects, viral loops, and retention mechanics.

deliverables.title: Detailed Development Script
deliverables.description: A step-by-step development roadmap. Phase 1 (MVP), Phase 2 (Growth), Phase 3 (Monetization), Phase 4 (Scale). For each phase: exact features to build, tech stack decisions, team requirements, timeline estimates, and success metrics.

deliverables.title: Complete UX Flow Diagrams
deliverables.description: Text-based UX flows for every user journey: architect onboarding, client browsing, supplier listing products, contractor bidding, content upload, inquiry flow, payment flow, comment/engagement flow. Include edge cases.

deliverables.title: Monetization Strategy
deliverables.description: Detailed pricing with justification. Compare to competitors (Houzz, Archilovers, Architizer). Include projections for user acquisition and revenue at different scales (100, 1000, 10000, 100000 users). Include the 'paid boost' mechanic where users pay to appear more popular.

deliverables.title: Database Schema
deliverables.description: Full database schema with tables, relationships, and key queries. Include: users, profiles, projects, frames, materials, comments, likes, views, inquiries, subscriptions, payments, ads, analytics events.

deliverables.title: API Specification
deliverables.description: RESTful API endpoints for all platform operations. Include authentication, pagination, filtering, sorting. Group by domain: auth, users, content, engagement, search, payments, admin.

deliverables.title: Content Strategy
deliverables.description: How to seed the platform with initial content. How to attract the first 100 architects. How to create engagement before there are many users. Content calendar for social media promotion. SEO strategy for architectural keywords in Serbian market.

deliverables.title: Supplier/Contractor Ecosystem Design
deliverables.description: Design the full ecosystem where every player has access to a wide network of related suppliers, contractors, and service providers. Include: how suppliers are categorized, how they connect with architects, how clients find them, how the platform facilitates transactions, and how advertising integrates naturally.

constraints: The visual reference to Pornhub is intentional and must be preserved — it's the brand identity
Primary market is Serbia/Western Balkans, secondary is broader European market
The platform must work for small independent architects AND large firms
Content quality must be high — there should be approval/curation mechanisms
The comment system must feel alive and engaging, not sterile
Every user type must have a clear path to value within their first session
Mobile-first design is essential — most browsing will be on phones
chatgpt_instructions.context_about_creator: Aleksandar is an architect who understands both the creative and business sides. He works with clients, suppliers, and contractors daily. He sees that the architecture industry lacks a central platform where all these players can discover each other, showcase work, and transact. The existing platforms (Houzz, Architizer, Archilovers) are either too corporate, too Western-focused, or lack the engagement mechanics that make modern content platforms sticky. ArhiHub aims to be the platform that architects actually enjoy using — where they spend time browsing, engaging, and discovering, not just uploading a portfolio entry once a year.
